courses.overview: 把公開航空製造案例延伸到檢測、接合與需求追溯。以下是民用工程方法的原創桌面練習，不提供經國號結構尺寸、性能改良或武器製造程序。
courses.overviewEn: Extend public aerospace manufacturing into inspection, joining and requirements traceability. These original desk exercises cover civilian engineering methods, not IDF dimensions, performance improvements or weapons manufacturing.

references.title: Quality Assurance
references.scope: 公開品質能力及量測、無損檢測方法的分類；未提供軍機工件尺寸或製造配方。
references.scopeEn: Public quality capabilities and metrology/NDT categories; no military-part dimensions or manufacturing recipes.

references.title: Aviation Handbooks & Manuals — Maintenance Technician handbooks
references.scope: 官方維修教育手冊入口；選讀 General／Airframe 的材料、圖面、檢查與紀錄原理。
references.scopeEn: Official maintenance-education handbook index; General/Airframe support materials, drawings, inspection and records principles.
references.titleEn: Aviation Handbooks & Manuals — Maintenance Technician handbooks

references.title: NASA Systems Engineering Handbook
references.scope: 需求、介面、驗證與組態管理的一般方法；不代表任何機型的原廠資料。
references.scopeEn: General requirements, interfaces, verification and configuration methods; not documentation for a particular aircraft or vehicle.

references.title: 2.008 Design and Manufacturing II (Spring 2025)
references.scope: 製程物理、製造設計、裝配、變異與品質的大學課程；跨域練習為本網站原創。
references.scopeEn: University material on process physics, manufacturing design, assembly, variation and quality; transfer exercises are original to this site.

references.title: Engineering Statistics Handbook — Measurement Process Characterization
references.scope: 量測偏差、重複性、再現性、校準與不確定度；不指定產品放行公差。
references.scopeEn: Measurement bias, repeatability, reproducibility, calibration and uncertainty; no product acceptance tolerances.
references.titleEn: Engineering Statistics Handbook — Measurement Process Characterization

related.title: 航空複材超音波檢測
related.why: 外觀良好無法排除複材內部分層，適合學習可觀察證據的限制。
related.whyEn: A clean surface cannot exclude internal delamination; learn the limits of observable evidence.
related.transfer: 把「缺陷假設—檢查方法—參考樣本」的配對方式轉用到一般複材零件。
related.transferEn: Transfer the pairing of defect hypothesis, inspection method and reference specimen to ordinary composite parts.
related.difference: 金屬尺寸量測與複材內部檢測解答不同問題；教學圖不構成缺陷判退標準。
related.differenceEn: Metal dimensional checks and composite internal inspection answer different questions; sketches are not rejection criteria.
practice: 畫出非飛行用夾層試片，標出表面及假想分層。
列出目視與超音波各能支持的判斷。
寫出還缺少的校準樣本、材料方向及授權驗收依據。
practiceEn: Sketch a nonflying sandwich coupon with a hypothetical delamination.
List what visual and ultrasonic evidence can each support.
Identify missing reference specimens, material orientation and approved acceptance criteria.

related.title: 三次元量床校準
related.why: 大型裝配孔位必須共享座標基準，否則兩份合格報告仍可能無法接合。
related.whyEn: Assembly hole locations need common datums; individually acceptable reports may otherwise disagree.
related.transfer: 轉用座標框架、探測策略與量測不確定度的紀錄方法。
related.transferEn: Transfer documentation of coordinate frames, probing strategy and measurement uncertainty.
related.difference: 校準設備不等於證明每個工件合格；溫度、夾持及取點也影響結果。
related.differenceEn: Instrument calibration does not certify every part; temperature, fixturing and sampling affect results.
practice: 替虛構支架指定三個基準特徵。
用自訂座標比較更換基準前後的孔位報告。
把儀器偏差與工件位置偏差分成兩欄。
practiceEn: Assign three datum features to a fictional bracket.
Compare hole coordinates before and after changing the datum using invented values.
Separate instrument bias from part-position error.

related.title: 航空線束製造與追溯
related.why: 線束將機械配置與電氣連通連在一起，也容易因版本不一致而裝錯。
related.whyEn: Harnesses connect mechanical layout and electrical continuity and are vulnerable to version mismatches.
related.transfer: 保留接頭、導線標識及修訂版之間的追溯關係，可轉用到民用設備線束。
related.transferEn: Trace connector, wire identification and revision relationships in civilian equipment harnesses.
related.difference: 連通測試不能取代絕緣、環境及安裝合適性驗證；不得推定實機腳位。
related.differenceEn: Continuity does not replace insulation, environmental or installation checks; do not infer aircraft pinouts.
practice: 畫三個虛構低壓模組的連接關係。
給每一條線與接頭唯一編號及版本。
模擬一個接頭變更，列出受影響的文件與檢查項目。
practiceEn: Draw connections among three fictional low-voltage modules.
Assign unique wire/connector IDs and revisions.
Simulate one connector change and list affected documents and checks.

related.title: 航電軟體需求追溯
related.why: 系統需求若無法連到測試結果，就難以判定修改是否完整。
related.whyEn: A requirement without linked test evidence makes change completeness difficult to assess.
related.transfer: 把需求、設計決策、測試與變更串成可雙向查找的證據表。
related.transferEn: Link requirements, design decisions, tests and changes in a bidirectional evidence table.
related.difference: 桌面軟體測試不等於航空軟體取證，也未涵蓋實機時序與失效條件。
related.differenceEn: Desk software tests are not aviation certification and omit real timing and failure conditions.
practice: 為虛構溫度顯示器寫三條可驗證需求。
每條需求連到一個正常與一個邊界測試。
改動顯示範圍後，標記需重新驗證的項目。
practiceEn: Write three testable requirements for a fictional temperature display.
Link each to a nominal and a boundary test.
Change its display range and mark evidence that needs renewal.

related.title: 航空鉚接接頭品質管理
related.why: 接頭品質連結孔位、材料、裝配順序與載荷路徑。
related.whyEn: Joint quality connects hole geometry, materials, assembly sequence and load paths.
related.transfer: 轉用基準一致性、接合前檢查與過程可追溯性到非承載教學接頭。
related.transferEn: Transfer datum consistency, pre-join checks and traceability to a nonstructural teaching joint.
related.difference: 外觀尺寸相似不代表疲勞與腐蝕行為相同；不同材料接合不能套用同一工法。
related.differenceEn: Similar appearance does not establish equal fatigue or corrosion behavior; joining methods depend on materials.
practice: 用紙板畫搭接與對接的載荷路徑。
建立孔位、材料批次與外觀的檢查表。
說明哪項問題需要材料試片而非照片判讀。
practiceEn: Draw load paths for lap and butt joints on cardboard.
Create a checklist for hole location, material lot and appearance.
Identify a question requiring material coupons rather than photographs.

related.title: 飛機系統故障樹分析
related.why: 整機正常運作需要多個功能同時成立，故障不能只逐零件理解。
related.whyEn: System operation depends on interacting functions, so failures cannot be understood component by component alone.
related.transfer: 用頂端事件、因果分支與共同原因分類，分析一般設備的功能中斷。
related.transferEn: Use top events, causal branches and common-cause categories for ordinary equipment outages.
related.difference: 未知故障率不能填成零；只有邏輯樹而無證據時，不宣稱可靠度數值。
related.differenceEn: Unknown failure rates are not zero; a logical tree alone cannot establish numerical reliability.
practice: 以「教學顯示器失去讀值」作頂端事件。
畫出電源、感測與資料路徑的概念分支。
找出兩個分支共用的依賴並標記未知證據。
practiceEn: Use loss of a teaching display reading as the top event.
Draw conceptual power, sensing and data-path branches.
Identify a shared dependency and mark unknown evidence.

courses.overview: 以阿帕契作公共案例入口，延伸到民用旋翼機的力學、振動、重量平衡與工作紀錄。練習只使用符號、虛構資料或桌面模型，不調整真實飛行器，也不涉及武器系統。
courses.overviewEn: Use the Apache as public context for civilian rotorcraft mechanics, vibration, weight/balance and work records. Exercises use symbols, fictional data or desk models, with no real aircraft adjustment or weapons systems.

references.title: Helicopter Flying Handbook
references.scope: 民用直升機力學、重量平衡與系統概念；不是阿帕契操作、維修或武器手冊。
references.scopeEn: Civil-helicopter mechanics, weight/balance and system concepts; not an Apache operating, maintenance or weapons manual.

references.title: 2.003SC Engineering Dynamics
references.scope: 剛體動力學、轉動、不平衡激振與振動模型；只用符號或低風險桌面模型。
references.scopeEn: Rigid-body dynamics, rotation, imbalance excitation and vibration models, used only in symbolic or low-risk desk exercises.

references.title: Rotorcraft Collective — preflight and icing education
references.scope: 飛前觀察、旅客安全與地面結冰的民用教育影片索引。
references.scopeEn: Civil educational video index for preflight observation, passenger safety and ground icing.
references.titleEn: Rotorcraft Collective — preflight and icing education

references.title: Aviation Handbooks & Manuals — Maintenance Technician handbooks
references.scope: 官方維修教育手冊入口；選讀 General／Airframe 的材料、圖面、檢查與紀錄原理。
references.scopeEn: Official maintenance-education handbook index; General/Airframe support materials, drawings, inspection and records principles.
references.titleEn: Aviation Handbooks & Manuals — Maintenance Technician handbooks

references.title: NASA Systems Engineering Handbook
references.scope: 需求、介面、驗證與組態管理的一般方法；不代表任何機型的原廠資料。
references.scopeEn: General requirements, interfaces, verification and configuration methods; not documentation for a particular aircraft or vehicle.

related.title: 直升機旋翼追蹤與平衡
related.why: 旋翼的週期運動讓振動方向與頻率成為可比較的證據。
related.whyEn: Periodic rotor motion makes vibration direction and frequency useful evidence.
related.transfer: 由簡化旋轉質量模型理解激振與量測的關係，再區分追蹤與平衡兩個問題。
related.transferEn: Use a simplified rotating-mass model to distinguish excitation, measurement, tracking and balance.
related.difference: 槳葉軌跡與質量不平衡不能互相替代；此練習不提供配重或槳距調整程序。
related.differenceEn: Blade tracking and mass balance are distinct; no balance-weight or blade-pitch adjustment procedure is supplied.
practice: 畫出理想旋轉平面與假想偏移軌跡。
將兩組自製正弦波標上頻率與相位。
列出判斷原因前仍需的轉速基準與感測方向。
practiceEn: Draw an ideal rotation plane and an imagined displaced track.
Label frequency and phase on two invented sine waves.
List required speed references and sensing directions before diagnosing a cause.

related.title: 飛機地面振動試驗
related.why: 結構自然頻率與旋轉激振頻率接近時，單看靜態剛度可能漏掉動態問題。
related.whyEn: Static stiffness alone can miss dynamic problems when forcing approaches a natural frequency.
related.transfer: 使用質量—彈簧—阻尼模型比較共振、阻尼與感測位置。
related.transferEn: Compare resonance, damping and sensor placement using a mass-spring-damper model.
related.difference: 單自由度示意不能替代具有多個模態的整機地面振動試驗。
related.differenceEn: A single-degree model cannot replace a whole-aircraft test with multiple modes.
practice: 畫一個單自由度模型並標出輸入與量測量。
用假設參數比較低阻尼與高阻尼頻率響應。
說明增加質量後，哪些原先的比較條件已改變。
practiceEn: Draw a single-degree model with input and measured output.
Compare frequency responses for assumed low and high damping.
Explain which comparison conditions change when mass is added.

related.title: 飛機重量與平衡管理
related.why: 相同總重量仍可能具有不同重心，功能配置必須連同位置考慮。
related.whyEn: Equal total mass can produce different centers of gravity, making placement part of system design.
related.transfer: 把質量、位置與力矩表的做法轉用到小型教學模型。
related.transferEn: Transfer mass-position-moment bookkeeping to small teaching models.
related.difference: 算出重心不等於符合飛行包線；本例不用阿帕契裝載資料。
related.differenceEn: A center-of-gravity calculation does not prove flight-envelope compliance; no Apache loading data is used.
practice: 為三個紙上模組指定任意一致單位的質量與位置。
計算移動同一模組前後的重心。
將計算結果與尚缺的允許範圍分開記錄。
practiceEn: Assign arbitrary consistent masses and locations to three paper modules.
Calculate the center of gravity before and after relocating one module.
Record the result separately from the still-unknown allowed envelope.

related.title: 飛機除冰防冰系統
related.why: 結冰可能同時影響外形、感測與地面活動，適合練習系統邊界。
related.whyEn: Icing can affect shape, sensing and ground activity, making it useful for system-boundary reasoning.
related.transfer: 建立環境條件—受影響功能—觀察證據的對照表。
related.transferEn: Map environmental conditions to affected functions and observable evidence.
related.difference: 防冰與除冰功能不同；通用教育材料不能當作特定機型放飛判定。
related.differenceEn: Anti-icing and deicing are different functions; general education is not an aircraft release decision.
practice: 從官方影片列出三種可觀察的結冰相關風險。
把事前避免與事後清除分成兩類功能。
標記必須查閱型號文件及合格人員決策的事項。
practiceEn: Identify three observable icing-related risks from official material.
Separate prevention from removal functions.
Mark decisions requiring type documentation and qualified personnel.

related.title: 航空維修數位工卡
related.why: 複雜維護跨多人與班次，口頭記憶不足以保存狀態。
related.whyEn: Complex maintenance spans people and shifts; memory alone cannot preserve work state.
related.transfer: 將完成條件、未決事項與覆核欄位轉成可交接的數位工卡。
related.transferEn: Transfer completion criteria, open issues and review fields into a handover-ready work card.
related.difference: 勾選欄位只記錄動作，不自動證明適航，也不能用來代替檢驗證據。
related.differenceEn: A checked box records an action, not airworthiness, and cannot replace inspection evidence.
practice: 為桌面模型的外觀檢查設計一張工卡。
加入人員、時間、版本、發現及附件欄位。
故意留下未決事項，確認下個人能辨識不能放行的原因。
practiceEn: Design a visual-inspection card for a desk model.
Include person, time, revision, findings and evidence fields.
Leave an open issue and verify that another reader can identify the hold reason.

related.title: 飛機系統故障樹分析
related.why: 多套功能共用電源或感測資料時，重複裝置不必然等於獨立備援。
related.whyEn: Duplicated equipment is not necessarily independent when power or sensor data are shared.
related.transfer: 把共同原因與依賴關係的分析轉用到民用監測系統。
related.transferEn: Transfer common-cause and dependency analysis to civilian monitoring systems.
related.difference: 沒有系統邊界與故障證據，不能由備援數量估算安全程度。
related.differenceEn: Redundancy count alone cannot establish safety without boundaries and failure evidence.
practice: 畫出兩個虛構顯示通道及其共用電源。
分別列出單通道與共用依賴失效。
寫出哪個假設需要新的驗證，而非再加一個顯示器。
practiceEn: Draw two fictional display channels and their shared supply.
Separate channel failures from shared-dependency failures.
Identify an assumption needing verification rather than another display.

courses.overview: 從公開水下載具案例轉向科學潛器的浮力、耐壓、介面與驗證。來源支持的是民用海洋研究原理；練習不設計軍用艦體、不製作載人耐壓容器，也不進行加壓試驗。
courses.overviewEn: Move from public underwater-vehicle context to scientific buoyancy, pressure, interfaces and verification. Sources support civilian ocean science; exercises do not design naval hulls, build human-occupied pressure vessels or conduct pressure tests.

references.title: How do ocean robots take the pressure?
references.scope: 科學水下載具的外壓、浮力與材料取捨；本延伸不提供耐壓艙製造尺寸。
references.scopeEn: External pressure, buoyancy and material tradeoffs in scientific vehicles; this extension provides no pressure-housing construction dimensions.
references.titleEn: How do ocean robots take the pressure?

references.title: Holding Up Under Pressure
references.scope: Alvin 浮力泡材的公開介紹與專業驗證背景，不是配方或自製壓力試驗指引。
references.scopeEn: Public background on Alvin flotation material and professional validation, not a formulation or home pressure-test procedure.

references.title: Alvin — User Supplied Equipment
references.scope: 民用科學儀器的重量、介面、材料與提交審查要求；不推廣到軍用艦艇規格。
references.scopeEn: Mass, interfaces, materials and review requirements for civilian science instruments; not naval-vessel specifications.

references.title: Micromodem
references.scope: 公開水聲資料傳輸與整體吞吐量的區別；不用於軍用通訊或隱蔽作業。
references.scopeEn: Public distinction between acoustic packet transmission and end-to-end throughput; no military communications or covert operations.

references.title: NASA Systems Engineering Handbook
references.scope: 需求、介面、驗證與組態管理的一般方法；不代表任何機型的原廠資料。
references.scopeEn: General requirements, interfaces, verification and configuration methods; not documentation for a particular aircraft or vehicle.

related.title: 水下科學機器人耐壓艙
related.why: 水下電子裝置的外殼不只是防水，還面對外部壓差。
related.whyEn: An underwater electronics enclosure faces external pressure differences as well as water exposure.
related.transfer: 把環境負載、材料限制與驗證證據分開列入設計需求表。
related.transferEn: Separate environmental loading, material constraints and verification evidence in requirements.
related.difference: 外壓失穩與內壓膨脹是不同問題；常壓容器或防潑水等級不能推定深水能力。
related.differenceEn: External-pressure instability differs from internal-pressure expansion; splash resistance does not establish depth capability.
practice: 畫出內外壓力方向，不標製造尺寸。
列出外殼、窗口與接頭各自需要的證據類型。
指出只有照片或材料名稱時仍無法判定的能力。
practiceEn: Sketch internal and external pressure directions without construction dimensions.
List evidence needed for the housing, window and connector separately.
Identify capabilities that photographs or material names cannot establish.

related.title: 水下機器人浮力材料
related.why: 載具增重會改變浮力需求，材料選擇不能只看強度。
related.whyEn: Added vehicle mass changes buoyancy requirements, so strength alone is an incomplete material criterion.
related.transfer: 用質量、排水體積與損傷狀態的分項帳，追蹤浮力變化。
related.transferEn: Track buoyancy changes with separate accounts for mass, displacement and damage state.
related.difference: 低密度不等於深海可用；壓縮、吸水及循環損傷都需要專業證據。
related.differenceEn: Low density does not establish deep-ocean suitability; compression, water uptake and cyclic damage need evidence.
practice: 用任意單位建立三個虛構材料的質量與體積表。
只比較理想浮力，再列出模型忽略的材料行為。
設計觀察紀錄欄位來區分初始狀態與服役後損傷。
practiceEn: Tabulate assumed masses and volumes for three fictional materials.
Compare ideal buoyancy and list omitted material behavior.
Design observation fields separating initial condition from service damage.

related.title: 海洋感測器水密接頭
related.why: 感測器整合常在接頭、電源與資料格式交界出現問題。
related.whyEn: Sensor integration often fails at connector, power and data-format boundaries.
related.transfer: 把機械、電氣、資料與環境限制寫成同一份介面表。
related.transferEn: Put mechanical, electrical, data and environmental constraints in one interface table.
related.difference: 接頭可插合不代表電壓、資料語意或耐環境能力相容；不用真實腳位圖推作。
related.differenceEn: Mating connectors do not prove electrical, semantic or environmental compatibility; no inferred real pinouts are used.
practice: 替虛構溫度記錄器列出四類介面。
用紙上例子找出一個單位或資料時間戳不一致。
建立需由供應者確認的未決欄位，不自行補上未知規格。
practiceEn: List four interface categories for a fictional temperature logger.
Find a units or timestamp mismatch in a paper example.
Create open fields for supplier confirmation rather than inventing specifications.

related.title: 水下聲學通訊
related.why: 水聲封包速率與有效資料到達率不同，等待與重傳也佔時間。
related.whyEn: Acoustic packet rate differs from useful delivery rate because waiting and retries consume time.
related.transfer: 把端到端延遲拆成傳輸、傳播、處理與回覆等時間帳。
related.transferEn: Break end-to-end delay into transmission, propagation, processing and acknowledgment.
related.difference: 無線網路的直覺不能直接套入水聲環境；本例不提供軍用通訊配置。
related.differenceEn: Radio-network assumptions do not transfer directly underwater; no military communication configuration is provided.
practice: 畫一段科學儀器到接收端的封包時間線。
以假設時間比較有回覆與無回覆的有效吞吐量。
分開標記量測值、假設值與尚未量到的時間。
practiceEn: Draw a packet timeline from a science instrument to its receiver.
Compare assumed throughput with and without acknowledgment.
Distinguish measured, assumed and unknown time terms.

related.title: 商船海上試航驗收
related.why: 單一元件通過檢查後，還需確認整合後的功能與資料紀錄。
related.whyEn: Component checks must be followed by integrated functional and data-record verification.
related.transfer: 借用試航驗收的需求—證據思路，建立不下水的桌面整合矩陣。
related.transferEn: Borrow acceptance-trial traceability to build a dry desk-integration matrix.
related.difference: 商船試航與潛器專業驗證的環境、風險及授權不同，不能共用通過門檻。
related.differenceEn: Merchant-vessel trials and submersible qualification have different conditions, risks and authorities.
practice: 為虛構科學載具列出電源、資料與狀態回報需求。
為每項需求指定可查驗的輸出及責任人。
把未驗證環境條件標成待辦，不以桌面成功替代。
practiceEn: List power, data and status-reporting requirements for a fictional science vehicle.
Assign inspectable output and an owner to each requirement.
Mark unverified environments as open rather than treating desk success as qualification.

related.title: Alvin 載人科學潛器
related.why: Alvin 展示了載具與外加科學儀器之間的整合關係。
related.whyEn: Alvin illustrates integration between a vehicle and user-supplied scientific instruments.
related.transfer: 從公開儀器提交要求學習重量、占用空間、材料與操作責任的協調。
related.transferEn: Use public instrument-submission requirements to study mass, volume, materials and responsibility coordination.
related.difference: 科學潛器的任務、認證與操作體系和國造潛艦不同，不能從前者反推後者規格。
related.differenceEn: Scientific submersibles differ from naval submarines in mission, certification and operation; one cannot reveal the other’s specifications.
practice: 畫出載具平台與一件虛構取樣儀器的功能邊界。
將需求分成平台提供與儀器提供兩欄。
模擬儀器增重，列出需通知及重新核對的介面。
practiceEn: Draw the boundary between a platform and a fictional sampling instrument.
Separate platform-provided and instrument-provided functions.
Simulate added instrument mass and list interfaces requiring review.

courses.overview: 把防禦網路延伸為身分、存取、復原、事件與工控界面的學習鏈。所有練習使用虛構資產、合成日誌或自己擁有的隔離測試資料，不對第三方系統掃描或更改設定。
courses.overviewEn: Extend defensive networking into identity, access, recovery, incidents and OT interfaces. Exercises use fictional assets, synthetic logs or owned isolated test data, without scanning third-party systems or changing their configuration.

references.title: SP 800-207 — Zero Trust Architecture
references.scope: 資源導向存取決策、身分與設備的驗證；只在自有隔離模型中練習。
references.scopeEn: Resource-oriented access decisions and identity/device verification, practiced only in owned isolated models.

references.title: Digital Identity Guidelines — Authentication and Authenticator Management (800-63-4)
references.scope: 驗證因子、驗證器生命週期與復原的技術背景；不在此聲稱合規認證。
references.scopeEn: Technical background on factors, authenticator lifecycle and recovery; no compliance certification is claimed here.
references.titleEn: Digital Identity Guidelines — Authentication and Authenticator Management (800-63-4)

references.title: SP 800-61 Rev. 3 — Incident Response Recommendations and Considerations
references.scope: 事件準備、偵測、回應與復原如何連結風險管理；練習使用虛構事件。
references.scopeEn: How incident preparation, detection, response and recovery connect with risk management; exercises use fictional incidents.
references.titleEn: SP 800-61 Rev. 3 — Incident Response Recommendations and Considerations

references.title: CSF 2.0 — Small Business Quick-Start Guide
references.scope: 小型組織資產、責任、保護與復原的入門框架。
references.scopeEn: An introductory framework for small-organization assets, responsibilities, protection and recovery.

references.title: SP 800-82 Rev. 3 — Guide to Operational Technology Security
references.scope: OT 架構與安全、可靠性、可用性限制；不得把紙上規則直接套入運轉產線。
references.scopeEn: OT architecture and safety, reliability and availability constraints; paper rules must not be applied directly to live production.
references.titleEn: SP 800-82 Rev. 3 — Guide to Operational Technology Security

related.title: 企業零信任網路
related.why: 網路位置不能單獨證明一個請求可信，需要明確的資源存取決策。
related.whyEn: Network location alone cannot establish trust; resource access needs explicit decisions.
related.transfer: 把主體、設備、資源、動作與條件整理成可檢驗的存取矩陣。
related.transferEn: Transfer subject-device-resource-action-condition reasoning into an inspectable access matrix.
related.difference: 零信任是架構原則，不是安裝一個產品或取消所有網路分區。
related.differenceEn: Zero trust is an architectural principle, not a single product or the removal of all segmentation.
practice: 列出三個虛構角色及兩個資料資源。
為讀取與修改各寫一條允許或拒絕條件。
測試離職、設備失去管理與權限過期三個紙上情境。
practiceEn: Define three fictional roles and two data resources.
Write allow/deny conditions for reading and editing.
Review departed-user, unmanaged-device and expired-access scenarios on paper.

related.title: 身分與存取管理
related.why: 帳號建立之後，角色變更與停權同樣會影響資料存取。
related.whyEn: Role changes and account suspension matter as much as account creation.
related.transfer: 用建立、變更、覆核、停用的生命週期追蹤權限來源。
related.transferEn: Track access provenance across creation, change, review and deactivation.
related.difference: 驗證身分與授予權限不同；登入成功不應直接代表可存取全部資源。
related.differenceEn: Authentication and authorization differ; a successful login does not grant every resource.
practice: 畫一個虛構新進人員到離職的流程。
為角色變更列出應新增及撤銷的權限。
設計一次權限覆核表，保留核准依據。
practiceEn: Draw a fictional joiner-to-leaver workflow.
List permissions added and removed after a role change.
Design an access-review record retaining approval evidence.

related.title: 多因素驗證系統
related.why: 多因素驗證需要獨立因子，不能把兩個密碼視為兩因素。
related.whyEn: Multifactor authentication needs distinct factors; two passwords are not two factors.
related.transfer: 將驗證器綁定、使用、遺失與復原串成完整的使用者流程。
related.transferEn: Connect authenticator binding, use, loss and recovery into a user lifecycle.
related.difference: 可用性、抗釣魚能力與復原風險要分開比較；不聲稱任一教學方案取得保證等級認證。
related.differenceEn: Compare usability, phishing resistance and recovery risk separately; no teaching design claims assurance-level certification.
practice: 分類幾個虛構登入方式所使用的因子。
寫出遺失第二因素時的紙上復原流程。
找出是否存在只靠弱問題就繞過較強驗證的環節。
practiceEn: Classify factors in fictional login methods.
Write a paper recovery flow for a lost second factor.
Look for a weak recovery question bypassing stronger authentication.

related.title: 災難復原與備份演練
related.why: 有備份檔不等於能在需要時恢復可用服務。
related.whyEn: A backup file does not establish that a usable service can be restored.
related.transfer: 把資料完整性、復原順序、時間及業務可用性分成可驗證證據。
related.transferEn: Separate data integrity, recovery order, elapsed time and usable service as evidence.
related.difference: 備份複製速度與復原目標不同；隔離練習成功不能代表生產環境已演練。
related.differenceEn: Copy speed differs from recovery objectives; an isolated exercise is not a production rehearsal.
practice: 在隔離資料夾建立無敏感內容的三個測試檔。
複製後恢復到另一個空資料夾並核對內容。
記錄步驟、耗時與未測試的相依服務。
practiceEn: Create three nonsensitive test files in an isolated folder.
Restore copies into a different empty folder and compare contents.
Record steps, elapsed time and untested service dependencies.

related.title: 安全資訊事件管理
related.why: 分散日誌需要一致時間、來源與事件語意才能支援調查。
related.whyEn: Distributed logs need consistent time, provenance and event semantics to support investigation.
related.transfer: 用合成事件建立時間線，保留原始紀錄與分析結論的分隔。
related.transferEn: Build a timeline from synthetic events while separating raw records from conclusions.
related.difference: 警報數量不能直接代表攻擊次數；重複、缺漏與時間偏差會改變解讀。
related.differenceEn: Alert counts are not attack counts; duplication, gaps and clock offsets affect interpretation.
practice: 自製登入、檔案存取及管理變更三類假日誌。
加上一筆重複事件與一個時間偏差，整理時間線。
為每個推論列出支持紀錄及仍缺少的證據。
practiceEn: Create fictional login, file-access and administrative-change logs.
Add a duplicate and a clock offset, then reconstruct a timeline.
Link each inference to supporting records and missing evidence.

related.title: 工控網路分區與隔離
related.why: 工控設備的可用性與物理安全可能受網路改動直接影響。
related.whyEn: Network changes can directly affect OT availability and physical safety.
related.transfer: 把資產功能、必要流量與信任邊界畫成可審查的分區圖。
related.transferEn: Map asset functions, necessary traffic and trust boundaries into a reviewable segmentation diagram.
related.difference: 辦公 IT 的更新與阻擋策略不能原樣套到連續運轉的控制系統。
related.differenceEn: Office-IT patching and blocking practices do not transfer unchanged to continuously operating control systems.
practice: 只在紙上畫感測、控制、監控及企業網路區域。
為每一條資料流說明方向與業務必要性。
列出任何規則變更前需確認的可用性與安全依賴。
practiceEn: Draw sensing, control, supervisory and enterprise zones on paper.
Explain the direction and operational purpose of each flow.
List availability and safety dependencies to review before any rule change.

courses.overview: 以蒸汽機車連接熱力學、往復機械、製造與量測史。理想循環和幾何模型用來理解能量與運動，不是鍋爐、壓力容器或實車運轉程序。
courses.overviewEn: Connect steam locomotives with thermodynamics, reciprocating mechanisms, manufacturing and measurement history. Ideal cycles and geometric models explain energy and motion, not boiler construction, pressure-vessel work or locomotive operation.

references.title: Phase Change Energy Conversion II
references.scope: 蒸汽循環與能量轉換的物理背景；機車排汽與理想封閉循環的差異須另列。
references.scopeEn: Physics of steam cycles and energy conversion; distinguish locomotive exhaust from ideal closed-cycle assumptions.

references.title: 2.003SC Engineering Dynamics
references.scope: 剛體動力學、轉動、不平衡激振與振動模型；只用符號或低風險桌面模型。
references.scopeEn: Rigid-body dynamics, rotation, imbalance excitation and vibration models, used only in symbolic or low-risk desk exercises.

references.title: 2.008 Design and Manufacturing II (Spring 2025)
references.scope: 製程物理、製造設計、裝配、變異與品質的大學課程；跨域練習為本網站原創。
references.scopeEn: University material on process physics, manufacturing design, assembly, variation and quality; transfer exercises are original to this site.

references.title: Engineering Statistics Handbook — Measurement Process Characterization
references.scope: 量測偏差、重複性、再現性、校準與不確定度；不指定產品放行公差。
references.scopeEn: Measurement bias, repeatability, reproducibility, calibration and uncertainty; no product acceptance tolerances.
references.titleEn: Engineering Statistics Handbook — Measurement Process Characterization

references.title: Loco speedometers and track-destroying trains
references.publisher: National Railway Museum / Science Museum Group
references.scope: 歷史速度紀錄與動力測試車量測的案例；不等同今日運轉許可。
references.scopeEn: Historical speed records and dynamometer-car measurement; not a present-day operating authorization.

related.title: 蒸汽能量收支與循環比較
related.titleEn: Steam energy accounting and cycle comparison
related.why: 燃料投入、汽缸作功與排熱之間需要一份一致的能量帳。
related.whyEn: Fuel input, cylinder work and rejected heat need a consistent energy account.
related.transfer: 將系統邊界與能量收支用於比較理想循環及開放排汽情境。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary and energy accounting to ideal-cycle and open-exhaust comparisons.
related.difference: 一般蒸汽機車排汽不等於帶冷凝器的理想封閉 Rankine 循環；不能直接照搬效率。
related.differenceEn: Typical locomotive exhaust is not an ideal closed Rankine cycle with a condenser; efficiencies cannot be copied directly.
practice: 畫出熱輸入、機械輸出及損失的概念箭頭。
用自訂能量單位建立守恆的收支表。
列出理想模型未納入的摩擦、洩漏與非穩態項。
practiceEn: Draw conceptual heat-input, work-output and loss arrows.
Build a balanced account using invented energy units.
List omitted friction, leakage and transient terms.

related.title: 活塞引擎曲軸製造
related.why: 連桿與曲柄把往復運動轉成轉動，幾何與製造基準互相影響。
related.whyEn: Rods and cranks convert reciprocation to rotation, linking geometry with manufacturing datums.
related.transfer: 把軸頸同軸性、曲柄位置與檢查基準的思路轉用到一般往復機械。
related.transferEn: Transfer journal-axis, crank-position and inspection-datum reasoning to ordinary reciprocating machines.
related.difference: 機車的曲柄輪、曲柄軸與汽車曲軸配置不必相同；不可用同一外形推定載荷。
related.differenceEn: Locomotive crank wheels/axles and automotive crankshafts differ; shape alone cannot establish loading.
practice: 用紙片與圖釘概念圖標出固定點及轉動中心。
畫出一圈轉動中三個角度的活塞位置。
為假想加工件列出兩個基準與對應的量測問題。
practiceEn: Sketch fixed points and rotation centers with a paper-linkage concept.
Draw piston positions at three crank angles.
Assign two datums and corresponding measurement questions to a fictional part.

related.title: 高速轉子動平衡
related.why: 不平衡力會隨轉動出現，單純加重並不保證振動降低。
related.whyEn: Imbalance produces rotating forces, and adding mass does not necessarily reduce vibration.
related.transfer: 用力向量與相位圖理解平衡的限制，再比較往復質量。
related.transferEn: Use force vectors and phase diagrams to understand balancing limits and compare reciprocating masses.
related.difference: 蒸汽機車含往復與轉動成分；純剛性轉子平衡不能完整消除所有動態力。
related.differenceEn: Locomotives combine reciprocating and rotating masses; rigid-rotor balance cannot eliminate every dynamic force.
practice: 畫兩個不同相位的假設旋轉力向量。
比較合力隨相位改變的方向與大小。
把模型未包含的往復慣性另列一欄。
practiceEn: Draw two assumed rotating-force vectors with different phases.
Compare resultant direction and magnitude as phase changes.
List reciprocating inertia separately as an omitted term.

related.title: 機械密封設計與檢驗
related.why: 運動界面需要同時考慮密封、摩擦與磨耗。
related.whyEn: Moving interfaces require attention to sealing, friction and wear together.
related.transfer: 用功能分解比較阻止介質流失、允許運動與維持表面的需求。
related.transferEn: Compare preventing leakage, allowing motion and preserving surfaces through functional decomposition.
related.difference: 現代旋轉機械密封與往復蒸汽填料不是可直接互換的零件；介質與溫度條件不同。
related.differenceEn: Modern rotary mechanical seals and reciprocating steam packing are not interchangeable; media and temperature conditions differ.
practice: 畫不帶壓力的滑動界面示意。
把洩漏路徑與接觸摩擦位置分開標記。
列出選型前需要的運動型態、介質及材料資料。
practiceEn: Sketch an unpressurized sliding interface.
Mark leakage paths separately from friction contacts.
List motion, medium and material information needed before selection.

related.title: 量測系統分析 GRR
related.why: 磨耗趨勢可能被量具或量測人的差異掩蓋。
related.whyEn: Instrument and operator differences can obscure a wear trend.
related.transfer: 把重複量測與不同觀察者量測分開記錄，先辨識量測系統變異。
related.transferEn: Separate repeated readings from between-observer readings to identify measurement variation.
related.difference: 幾個教學讀值不足以完成工業 GRR 或宣告零件可繼續運轉。
related.differenceEn: A few teaching readings cannot establish industrial GRR or continued-service acceptance.
practice: 用一個無安全功能的物件設計重複量測表。
以假設資料區分同一人重測與不同人量測。
寫出判斷磨耗之前仍需的基準與量測不確定度。
practiceEn: Design a repeated-measurement table for a noncritical object.
Use assumed data to separate within- and between-observer variation.
Identify the baseline and uncertainty needed before judging wear.

related.title: LNER Mallard 蒸汽機車
related.why: Mallard 的歷史紀錄可用來學習性能主張如何依賴量測。
related.whyEn: Mallard’s historical record illustrates how performance claims depend on measurement.
related.transfer: 將現場指示、獨立量測與資料記錄的區別轉用到工程展示。
related.transferEn: Transfer the distinction between indications, independent measurements and records to engineering demonstrations.
related.difference: 歷史最高速度不能代表長期可靠度、今天的運轉狀態或其他機車能力。
related.differenceEn: A historical peak speed does not establish endurance, present operating condition or another locomotive’s capability.
practice: 整理博物館文章中的主張及量測手段。
把「瞬時峰值」與「可持續性能」列成兩個問題。
為一次虛構模型車展示提出獨立驗證證據。
practiceEn: List claims and measurement methods in the museum article.
Separate peak performance from sustained performance questions.
Propose independent evidence for a fictional model-vehicle demonstration.

courses.overview: 從公開汽車製造延伸到接合、表面品質、鑄造、量測與產線分析。能轉用的是製程與證據的推理方法，不能把個別車型的工法或公差當作所有汽車的標準。
courses.overviewEn: Extend public automotive manufacturing into joining, surfaces, casting, metrology and production-flow analysis. Transfer process and evidence reasoning, while keeping model-specific methods and tolerances separate.

references.title: Inside the Factory: The Body Welding Plant
references.scope: 官方公開車身裝配與品質檢查案例；不同年份、車型及材料不能直接沿用參數。
references.scopeEn: Official public body-assembly and quality-check example; parameters do not transfer automatically across years, models or materials.
references.titleEn: Inside the Factory: The Body Welding Plant

references.title: 2.008 Design and Manufacturing II (Spring 2025)
references.scope: 製程物理、製造設計、裝配、變異與品質的大學課程；跨域練習為本網站原創。
references.scopeEn: University material on process physics, manufacturing design, assembly, variation and quality; transfer exercises are original to this site.

references.title: Engineering Statistics Handbook — Measurement Process Characterization
references.scope: 量測偏差、重複性、再現性、校準與不確定度；不指定產品放行公差。
references.scopeEn: Measurement bias, repeatability, reproducibility, calibration and uncertainty; no product acceptance tolerances.
references.titleEn: Engineering Statistics Handbook — Measurement Process Characterization

references.title: Engineering Statistics Handbook — Process or Product Monitoring and Control
references.scope: 製程監控、管制圖與品質判讀的方法；管制界限不是設計規格界限。
references.scopeEn: Methods for process monitoring, control charts and quality interpretation; control limits are not design specification limits.
references.titleEn: Engineering Statistics Handbook — Process or Product Monitoring and Control

related.title: 汽車白車身焊裝
related.why: 車身板件需同時符合接合、幾何與後續裝配需求。
related.whyEn: Body panels must satisfy joining, geometry and downstream assembly needs together.
related.transfer: 把基準、夾持、接合順序與檢查點串成可追溯流程。
related.transferEn: Connect datums, fixturing, joining order and inspection points into a traceable flow.
related.difference: 外觀接縫與結構接合品質不同；官方案例也不代表所有年份及車型。
related.differenceEn: An attractive panel gap does not establish structural joint quality, and a published example is not universal.
practice: 畫三片虛構車身板件及定位基準。
比較兩種接合順序會如何影響量測可達性。
把外觀、尺寸及接合內部品質分成三類證據。
practiceEn: Sketch three fictional body panels and their locating datums.
Compare how two joining orders affect measurement access.
Separate appearance, dimensions and internal joint-quality evidence.

related.title: 珩磨與孔面品質
related.why: 精密孔面需要把尺寸、形狀與表面紋理分開理解。
related.whyEn: Precision bores require separate reasoning about size, form and surface texture.
related.transfer: 轉用加工前後基準一致性與多項品質量的檢查思路。
related.transferEn: Transfer consistent before/after datums and multiple quality measures to bore inspection.
related.difference: 鏡面感不等於合適表面；珩磨紋理、圓度及尺寸不能互相代替。
related.differenceEn: A mirror-like appearance is not sufficient; honing texture, roundness and size are different attributes.
practice: 畫一個虛構孔的軸向與周向取樣位置。
為直徑、圓度及粗糙度分別指定需要的資料。
說明只看一張內孔照片會漏掉哪些問題。
practiceEn: Mark axial and circumferential sample positions on a fictional bore.
Specify evidence for diameter, roundness and roughness separately.
Explain what a single bore photograph cannot reveal.

related.title: 精密脫蠟鑄造
related.why: 複雜金屬形狀可從模具、凝固與後加工的關係開始理解。
related.whyEn: Complex metal shapes can be studied through tooling, solidification and finishing relationships.
related.transfer: 把幾何可製造性、材料轉換與缺陷查驗串成製程選擇表。
related.transferEn: Connect geometric manufacturability, material transformation and defect evidence in a process-choice table.
related.difference: 脫蠟鑄造、砂模鑄造與壓鑄不是同一路線；本項不聲稱 Ferrari 指定零件採用脫蠟工法。
related.differenceEn: Investment, sand and die casting are different routes; this item makes no claim that a particular Ferrari part uses investment casting.
practice: 選一個自繪的非承載金屬外形。
列出模具可移除性、收縮及後加工的三類問題。
比較兩種鑄造路線仍需要哪些材料與品質資料。
practiceEn: Choose a self-drawn nonstructural metal shape.
List tooling removal, shrinkage and finishing questions.
Compare information needed to assess two casting routes.

related.title: 量測系統分析 GRR
related.why: 裝配公差越小，越需要知道變異來自零件還是量測系統。
related.whyEn: Tighter assembly demands make it more important to distinguish part variation from measurement variation.
related.transfer: 把重複性、觀察者差異與零件差異分開記錄。
related.transferEn: Record repeatability, observer differences and part differences separately.
related.difference: 提高讀數小數位並不等於提高量測能力；示例數據不是 Ferrari 實測。
related.differenceEn: More displayed decimal places do not establish better capability; example data are not Ferrari measurements.
practice: 建立三個虛構零件、兩位觀察者的量測表。
以合成讀數展示同一零件反覆量測的分散。
列出正式 GRR 之前需確認的抽樣與方法一致性。
practiceEn: Build a table for three fictional parts and two observers.
Use synthetic readings to show repeated-measurement spread.
List sampling and method-consistency conditions needed for formal GRR.

related.title: 工廠統計製程管制
related.why: 只檢查最後成品，可能來不及看到製程已逐漸漂移。
related.whyEn: End-product inspection can miss an earlier process drift.
related.transfer: 把時間順序與製程分組保留下來，先問過程是否穩定。
related.transferEn: Preserve time order and process grouping before judging stability.
related.difference: 管制圖界限反映過程行為，規格界限來自設計；穩定也不保證符合規格。
related.differenceEn: Control limits describe process behavior; specification limits come from design. Stability does not guarantee conformity.
practice: 自製一組帶有緩慢漂移的尺寸資料。
標記取樣順序、工站與量具版本。
將穩定性問題與是否超出假設規格分開討論。
practiceEn: Create a synthetic dimension series with gradual drift.
Label sample order, station and instrument revision.
Separate stability from conformity to an assumed specification.

related.title: 工廠輸送線節拍平衡
related.why: 手工與自動化混合的產線容易在交接點產生等待。
related.whyEn: Mixed manual and automated lines can accumulate waiting at handoffs.
related.transfer: 把加工時間、搬運、等待與重工分開，尋找限制吞吐量的步驟。
related.transferEn: Separate processing, transport, waiting and rework to identify a throughput constraint.
related.difference: 宣傳影片的剪輯長度不是工站週期；增加單站速度不一定提高整線產出。
related.differenceEn: Edited video duration is not station cycle time; a faster station may not improve total output.
practice: 畫三個假想工站及緩衝區。
用自訂時間比較瓶頸前後的在製品累積。
列出需要現場觀測才能驗證的假設。
practiceEn: Draw three hypothetical stations and buffers.
Use invented times to compare work-in-process around a bottleneck.
List assumptions that need real observations.

courses.overview: 以電動車功能架構連接熱管理、控制、功率轉換、充電與產線。這些是跨品牌原理與原創紙上模型，不能替代特定車型維修資料；不拆解電池或操作高壓線路。
courses.overviewEn: Connect EV architecture with thermal management, control, power conversion, charging and manufacturing flow. These cross-brand principles and original paper models do not replace model-specific service information; no pack disassembly or high-voltage work is involved.

references.title: How Do All-Electric Cars Work?
references.scope: 一般電動車的電池、馬達、功率電子、充電與熱系統功能；不是特斯拉線路圖。
references.scopeEn: Functions of EV batteries, motors, power electronics, charging and thermal systems; not a Tesla circuit diagram.

references.title: Electric Vehicles for Consumers
references.scope: 充電類別與連接器的使用者層級介紹；地區、年份與車型相容性另行確認。
references.scopeEn: User-level charging categories and connectors; region, date and vehicle compatibility require separate checking.

references.title: Vehicle Thermal Management
references.scope: 車輛電池、空調與整合熱管理研究；練習只做能量與熱阻示意。
references.scopeEn: Research on batteries, HVAC and integrated vehicle thermal management; exercises use only energy and thermal-resistance models.

references.title: Manufacturing
references.scope: 公開工廠與製造系統概覽；不支持由宣傳影片反推真實節拍或良率。
references.scopeEn: Public factory and manufacturing-system overview; promotional footage cannot establish actual takt time or yield.

references.title: 2.008 Design and Manufacturing II (Spring 2025)
references.scope: 製程物理、製造設計、裝配、變異與品質的大學課程；跨域練習為本網站原創。
references.scopeEn: University material on process physics, manufacturing design, assembly, variation and quality; transfer exercises are original to this site.

related.title: 電動車電池熱管理
related.why: 電池平均溫度與局部溫差是不同問題，且會和車艙熱需求競爭資源。
related.whyEn: Average pack temperature and local gradients differ, while cabin and component systems may share thermal resources.
related.transfer: 用熱源、熱阻與冷卻邊界圖辨識局部熱點及熱流方向。
related.transferEn: Identify local hot spots and heat-flow direction using sources, resistances and cooling boundaries.
related.difference: 降低平均溫度不自動消除局部風險；簡化熱網路不是熱失控驗證。
related.differenceEn: Lower average temperature does not automatically eliminate local risk; a thermal network is not runaway validation.
practice: 畫三個假想熱節點及環境邊界。
比較一個局部熱源與均勻熱源的情境。
列出還需要的材料、介面與感測位置資料。
practiceEn: Draw three assumed thermal nodes and an ambient boundary.
Compare localized and uniform heat generation.
List missing material, interface and sensing-location data.

related.title: 電動車電池管理系統
related.why: 電池管理需要將感測、估計與限制決策分開理解。
related.whyEn: Battery management requires separating sensing, estimation and limit decisions.
related.transfer: 把真實量、估計狀態及控制命令整理成訊號關係圖。
related.transferEn: Map measured quantities, estimated states and control commands separately.
related.difference: 荷電狀態不是單靠一次電壓就能保證的真值；通用功能圖不揭露 Tesla 演算法。
related.differenceEn: State of charge is not guaranteed by one voltage reading; a generic diagram does not disclose Tesla algorithms.
practice: 畫電壓、電流、溫度輸入及狀態估計方塊。
以合成資料標記遺失或不一致的感測值。
說明資料不足時哪些結論應保持未知。
practiceEn: Draw voltage, current and temperature inputs with a state-estimation block.
Mark missing or inconsistent readings in synthetic data.
State which conclusions must remain unknown when evidence is insufficient.

related.title: 電動車功率逆變器
related.why: 馬達與電池之間需要電能轉換與控制，而不只是直接連接。
related.whyEn: Motor and battery interaction requires conversion and control rather than a simple direct connection.
related.transfer: 用能量流與損失帳區分直流端、轉換器與機械輸出。
related.transferEn: Distinguish DC input, conversion and mechanical output with an energy-flow and loss account.
related.difference: 平均功率模型不能描述開關波形、電磁相容性或實際保護設計。
related.differenceEn: An average-power model omits switching waveforms, EMC and real protective design.
practice: 畫電池、功率電子、馬達與負載的方塊圖。
用任意能量單位保持輸入等於輸出加損失。
把控制訊號與承載能量的路徑畫成不同線型。
practiceEn: Draw battery, power-electronics, motor and load blocks.
Balance input, output and losses using arbitrary energy units.
Distinguish control signals from energy-carrying paths.

related.title: 汽車回生制動整合
related.why: 減速時的能量可能回到電池，但接收能力與減速需求未必一致。
related.whyEn: Deceleration energy may return to the battery, but acceptance and braking demand need not match.
related.transfer: 把車輛動能、回收、耗散與限制條件建立成完整能量帳。
related.transferEn: Account for kinetic energy, recovery, dissipation and constraints together.
related.difference: 可回收能量不等於所有煞車需求；道路安全功能不能由紙上效率推算。
related.differenceEn: Recoverable energy is not the entire braking requirement; paper efficiency cannot establish road safety.
practice: 對虛構車輛比較兩個速度狀態的動能。
假設一個回收上限，將其餘能量列入耗散。
列出電池狀態、輪胎路面與制動功能的模型邊界。
practiceEn: Compare kinetic energy at two speeds for a fictional vehicle.
Assume a recovery limit and account for remaining dissipation.
List battery-state, road-contact and braking-function limits of the model.

related.title: 電動車充電連接介面
related.why: 相同外形或品牌並不保證充電模式與車輛相容。
related.whyEn: Connector appearance or branding alone does not establish charging compatibility.
related.transfer: 以機械連接、電能模式、通訊與設備能力四欄檢查介面。
related.transferEn: Review mechanical mating, energy mode, communication and equipment capability separately.
related.difference: AC 充電與 DC 充電的轉換位置不同；地區與年份會影響可用連接器。
related.differenceEn: AC and DC charging place conversion differently; connector availability depends on region and date.
practice: 用官方資料畫 AC 與 DC 充電的轉換方塊。
為虛構車輛建立相容性資訊需求表。
把已核實、需要轉接確認及未知項分別標記。
practiceEn: Draw AC/DC conversion blocks from official descriptions.
Create a compatibility-information checklist for a fictional vehicle.
Separate verified, adapter-dependent and unknown items.

related.title: 工廠輸送線節拍平衡
related.why: 電動車總裝仍需協調物料、檢測與人機工站交接。
related.whyEn: EV final assembly still coordinates material, inspection and human-machine handoffs.
related.transfer: 把需求節拍、工站能力與緩衝分開，分析整線而非單一機器。
related.transferEn: Separate demand takt, station capability and buffers when analyzing the whole line.
related.difference: 公開廠房影片不提供完整停機、換線或重工分布，不能據此估算量產產能。
related.differenceEn: Public factory footage omits full downtime, changeover and rework distributions and cannot establish production capacity.
practice: 建立四工站的虛構物料流。
指定假設週期與一次重工支線。
比較改善瓶頸及改善非瓶頸的整線影響。
practiceEn: Create a fictional four-station material flow.
Assign assumed cycle times and one rework branch.
Compare improving a bottleneck with improving a non-bottleneck.

courses.overview: 把星鏈的公開功能拆成通訊、平台、電力、熱管理與退役責任，再連到一般小衛星工程。不同衛星世代與其他小衛星案例的數據不能混用；以下不提供飛行硬體施工或軌道操作指令。
courses.overviewEn: Separate public Starlink functions into communications, bus, power, thermal management and retirement responsibilities, then connect them to small-spacecraft engineering. Keep generations and other spacecraft examples separate; no flight-hardware build or orbital-operation commands are supplied.

references.title: Starlink Technology
references.scope: 公開平台、電力、無線及光學鏈路功能；硬體數量與性能須對照世代，本文不固定宣稱。
references.scopeEn: Public bus, power, radio and optical-link functions; hardware counts/performance depend on generation and are not fixed here.

references.title: State-of-the-Art of Small Spacecraft Technology
references.publisher: NASA Small Spacecraft Systems Virtual Institute
references.scope: 公開小衛星電力、通訊、整合等子系統索引；技術例子不等於 Starlink 原廠配置。
references.scopeEn: Public small-spacecraft power, communications and integration references; examples are not Starlink manufacturer configurations.

references.title: 7.0 Thermal Control
references.publisher: NASA Small Spacecraft Systems Virtual Institute
references.scope: 太空熱傳與熱控制方法；不提供特定星系的飛行溫度或試驗配方。
references.scopeEn: Spacecraft heat transfer and thermal-control methods; no constellation-specific flight temperatures or test recipes.

references.title: Orbital Debris Program Office — Debris Mitigation
references.scope: 碎片減緩與任務結束規劃的公開背景；不是跨國法規適用性判定。
references.scopeEn: Public background on debris mitigation and end-of-mission planning; not a determination of international regulatory applicability.
references.titleEn: Orbital Debris Program Office — Debris Mitigation

references.title: NASA Systems Engineering Handbook
references.scope: 需求、介面、驗證與組態管理的一般方法；不代表任何機型的原廠資料。
references.scopeEn: General requirements, interfaces, verification and configuration methods; not documentation for a particular aircraft or vehicle.

related.title: 衛星地面站通訊鏈路
related.why: 用戶終端、衛星與地面網路構成多段連線，每段限制不同。
related.whyEn: User terminals, satellites and ground networks form multiple links with different constraints.
related.transfer: 把端到端連線拆成介面與延遲項，避免只用距離估算整體服務。
related.transferEn: Break end-to-end connectivity into interfaces and delay terms instead of inferring service from distance alone.
related.difference: 傳播延遲只是總延遲的一部分；公開功能介紹不是實際服務保證。
related.differenceEn: Propagation is only one delay component; public functional descriptions are not service guarantees.
practice: 畫終端、衛星、地面接入及網際網路節點。
為各段標記傳播、處理及排隊的可能來源。
對未公開的路徑與時間明確保留未知。
practiceEn: Draw terminal, satellite, ground-access and internet nodes.
Mark possible propagation, processing and queueing terms.
Leave undisclosed paths and times explicitly unknown.

related.title: 低軌衛星網路路由
related.why: 低軌節點會相對移動，連線圖也會隨時間改變。
related.whyEn: Low-orbit nodes move relative to one another, changing the connectivity graph over time.
related.transfer: 用時間分段的圖模型比較可用路徑與連線中斷。
related.transferEn: Compare available routes and interruptions with time-indexed graph models.
related.difference: 有光學鏈路不代表所有資料必經光學路徑；真實路由政策並未由示意圖揭露。
related.differenceEn: Optical links do not imply every packet uses them, and a sketch does not disclose operational routing policy.
practice: 自繪三個時間點的六節點網路圖。
在一條邊不可用時找出仍存在的概念路徑。
比較跳數最少與假設延遲最少的路徑是否相同。
practiceEn: Draw six-node network graphs at three times.
Find a conceptual surviving path after removing one edge.
Compare minimum-hop and assumed minimum-delay routes.

related.title: 衛星太陽能陣列展開
related.why: 太陽能陣列同時有發電與機械展開功能，不能只看額定功率。
related.whyEn: Solar arrays combine generation and deployment functions, not merely rated power.
related.transfer: 把收納、展開、遮蔽與供電需求當成互相影響的介面。
related.transferEn: Treat stowage, deployment, shading and power demand as interacting interfaces.
related.difference: 紙上展開成功不代表能承受發射或太空環境；不同衛星陣列配置不能混用。
related.differenceEn: A paper deployment does not establish launch or space-environment qualification, and configurations vary by spacecraft.
practice: 畫收納與展開兩種概念狀態。
用假設時段建立日照、負載與儲能的能量帳。
指出機構卡滯與供電不足分別需要哪類證據。
practiceEn: Sketch stowed and deployed conceptual states.
Use assumed intervals to account for sunlight, load and storage.
Identify distinct evidence for mechanism jamming and insufficient power.

related.title: 太空儀器熱真空試驗
related.why: 太空環境改變熱傳路徑，地面有風冷卻的直覺不一定適用。
related.whyEn: Space changes heat-transfer paths, so air-cooled ground intuition may fail.
related.transfer: 把熱源、導熱介面與輻射邊界列入模型及驗證計畫。
related.transferEn: Include heat sources, conduction interfaces and radiation boundaries in the model and verification plan.
related.difference: 熱平衡模型與熱真空試驗目的不同；本練習不提供真空設備操作程序。
related.differenceEn: Thermal-balance models and thermal-vacuum tests serve different purposes; no vacuum-equipment procedure is provided.
practice: 畫電子熱源到外表面的概念熱路徑。
分開比較日照與陰影的假設邊界。
寫出一個模型預測，以及需用什麼量測證據檢驗它。
practiceEn: Draw a conceptual path from electronics heat sources to external surfaces.
Compare assumed sunlit and shadow boundaries.
State one model prediction and the evidence needed to check it.

related.title: 太空碎片減緩與退役
related.why: 工程任務的責任延伸到停止服務之後，退役需要早期納入需求。
related.whyEn: Engineering responsibility continues after service ends, so retirement belongs in early requirements.
related.transfer: 用生命週期檢核把正常結束與故障後情境分開。
related.transferEn: Use lifecycle review to distinguish nominal retirement from failure scenarios.
related.difference: 碎片減緩原則不是任何地區的完整法規判定；不在此推算或下達軌道機動。
related.differenceEn: Mitigation principles are not complete jurisdiction-specific legal determinations; no orbital maneuvers are calculated or commanded here.
practice: 為虛構衛星建立服務開始到結束的責任表。
分別列出正常退役與失去部分功能後的未決問題。
標記需要主管機關、營運者及專業評估的證據。
practiceEn: Create a responsibility table from commissioning to retirement for a fictional satellite.
List open questions for nominal retirement and partial failure.
Mark evidence requiring authorities, operators and professional assessment.

related.title: CubeSat 小衛星系統工程
related.why: 小衛星能清楚展示有限資源下如何協調需求與子系統。
related.whyEn: Small spacecraft clearly illustrate requirements and subsystem coordination under limited resources.
related.transfer: 把質量、功率、資料及熱負載分配到可追溯的介面帳。
related.transferEn: Allocate mass, power, data and thermal loads through traceable interface accounts.
related.difference: CubeSat 的尺寸與標準化介面不能當成 Starlink 衛星的實際配置。
related.differenceEn: CubeSat sizes and standardized interfaces are not Starlink configurations.
practice: 為虛構科學小衛星指定一項任務目標。
建立四種資源的假設分配表，明示預留量。
模擬新增感測器後，標記哪些其他預算也要重新檢查。
practiceEn: Assign one mission objective to a fictional science satellite.
Create four assumed resource budgets with explicit reserves.
Add a sensor and identify other budgets needing review.
